src: But, here comes the disappointment. It's not gonna vanish. It's here and it's gonna stay.
Do you understand? There's nothing we can do about it.
So could the flesh growth be influenced at least?
Curtailing the flesh seems to be impossible. Holding it back from growing and thus conquering the whole world.
Trying to stop it is like trying to put the genie back into the bottle and corking it with a stopper.
I don't think we're able to do it.
There's no way the flesh growth could be stopped?
We might hold them off. Here, on Nexus. At least make sure that they're not able to leave the planet.
See, my biggest concern would be the flesh taking over other worlds.
Think about all the people on these other worlds. What would happen if the flesh invaded their homes?
Do you know any other worlds?
Do you know how the flesh would travel to other worlds?
That all seems a bit vague to me.
Maybe. I don't know. I need to think this through.
I'm a doctor. I don't kill people. Usually.
I need to get rid of some flesh maggots.
Ah. Yeah, I got something that could help.
But it's an important ingredient of my liver medicine.
I can't share it with you.
But if you can bring me some materials I can mix it up for you.
I need some ethanol, a poisonous fungus, and some juice to keep the lab running.
Ok. I'll go looking for that.
We're out in the wastes here.
And the lab isn't gonna run on it's own.
I need something to induce energy.
Bright, yellow, usually grows in caves.
You're an adult. I'm sure you'll find that somewhere.
And make sure it's the good stuff.
Here are the things you asked for.
Did you just drink the booze?
I thought you needed it as an ingredient.
That's why I'm a doctor, and you're not.
I should probably hurry back to the Puke Bar before it's overrun by maggots.
I don't feel so well. Can you examine me?
The Machines said that I am contaminated.
You're from one of the habitats?
Ok. Let me take a quick look.
But that's expected if you're freshly exposed to the environment around here.
Can't see anything else on the scanner that would be a cause for your sickness.
Sorry, but seems I can't help you there.
It's a long shot, but Mortus is researching the flesh and how it affects us humans.
He showed up a while ago and set up his base here in the underground beneath us.
Maybe he could take a look at you.
Here are the brains and the Octagon fluid.
What? I didn't ask for that.
Do you have a spare medical scanner?
Mortus wants to examine me and needs better equipment for that.
Mortus said I would give you one?
Alright. I guess I could lend it to Mortus.
RESPONSE UNITS FROM GROUP B HAVE BEEN SET TO REST MODE.
All that traveling. All those miles. On foot.
It's in your gait, you know?
Nah, not really. It's just that a guy told me about it once.
Oh, man, was he disappointed that he couldn't get into the Temple here in the city.
He looked all sad and stuff.
I have visited the Puke Bar.
THE Puke Bar? Oh my god.
Was it gross? Did you get drunk?
It's... well, I guess it was.
I don't remember if I got drunk.
I'm a friend of the Fleshkraken.
Did he try to eat you before you became his friend?
Uhm, maybe. I am not so sure.
I wonder what it's like to get eaten by a Flesh Titan.
Well, we would have to ask Fleshface about that.
Long story. Maybe I'll get back to it at some point.
I overthrew the Administration of this city.
I wondered what happened. There are rumors, but no one could tell me anything concrete.
I was kind of glad to see the machines leaving this place.
I am glad that you fought alongside our own team, haha.
Protas tells me that it's us who are in charge now. I guess we'll have to see about that.
I mean, not a fan of the new machines here.
But I guess they haven't killed anyone so far, so maybe that's better.
Are you new here? Did you come from outside?
When I left the Silent City I was a bit lost at first, but then I found this place. And then I was too afraid to leave again. Because of all the scary stuff out there.
But you, you must be a hero. Like one of the characters from the Cyberwomb tales.
A scoundrel. A lonesome wanderer. A scion of Prometheus.
Please, tell me about one of your heroic feats.
Leave me be and continue your journey.
Continue enjoying this world. I'm gonna rescue it for all of us.
She was my stars. Now she's the black sky, flickering, drifting into darkness.
I'll punch the Evergrowing Heart so it will pump again.
You don't know anything, do you?
I'll get them, one by one, until I know where the heart is.
Kill them all, if I have to.
You should be thanking me. What good would this world be if the flesh dies?
A dead planet. Humans crawling on it like maggots.
And I am not even hungry.
Bleh. How can this thing live?
What do you want to talk about, fellow human?
I would like to talk about our plans.
I'm not really sure what we're up to.
I would like to meet new people.
Actually, I have someone big and meaty in need of a friend.
Maybe we should meet that someone.
You said you left the Machine Masters. Why?
I want to mingle among the humans.
I'm alone. I'm different than the other machines.
And I don't want to become like the machines again.
So I have to become something else.
I want to become similar to the humans.
I'm a multi-purpose cyborg. I was created as a worker and protector.
To the Machine Masters and therefore also for the humans, of course.
I gave myself the flesh face to be more alike humans. Therefore I am Fleshface.
There's a funnel sticking out of him. Maybe... organic lubricant?
I was one of your masters. Here to protect you.
To shield you from the dangers of this world.
But that was in my previous life.
I left the masters to become one of you.
Is that why someone destroyed you?
I don't know. I don't have any memory of me getting destroyed.
Are you the one who activated me again?
I would like to continue my travels. Exploring. Getting to know people.
Perhaps you could separate my head from my body and carry me around?
I'm fully self-sufficient. I won't be a burden to you.
I just want to experience life. Make friends. See new places.
Already took the most important part.
Say, you're here for the steaks, too?
They wanna get rid of everyone. Us. The Titans.
I bet they even have it in for the Machines.
So, you're here for the steaks?
Yes. I heard that this house has a cellar, and there's a hidden path.
Somewhere behind the house, among the rocks.
Yeah. You eat one, and when you fall asleep you start seeing reality as it is.
But it's difficult to get hold of one, with all these Godhunters around.
Steaks so good, they make your brain melt.
And they make you see things. See visions. The truth.
What? Why else would you be here then?
But while you're here: Maybe you could help me with a thing?
I want you to sneak into the cellar and get me a piece of the Butcher's Cut.
There's got to be some of it somewhere.
I heard about a hidden entrance behind the house, among the rocks.
You're lucky none of the Godhunters got to you while you were wandering around.
Exit's down there. But maybe you'd like to stay here and help me with a thing?
